comment: Eight shared developer lanes on the 16-Spark fleet (PR #1082 baseline). One driver family per lane. Budgets are per node per lane; the eight lanes together must stay inside the verified envelope: 78336 MiB total reservation + 8192 MiB queue headroom per Spark. Ports: lane L owns control 23000+16L .. +15, collective 53000+16L .. +15 (u16-valid, clear of every fleet_registry block), transport 64000+16L .. +15. Exclusive reservations are MANAGER-AUTHORIZED ONLY (phase 2, critical benchmarks); routine work is smoke tests + small B* under shared lanes with same-conditions A/B discipline.
